# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Foley Auctioneers is delighted to bring to the the market, this superb four bedroom detached residence, set in the much sought-after development of Seachnall Abbey, offering an exceptional opportunity to acquire a stylish and spacious family home in one of Dunshaughlin’s most desirable locations.

- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed
- Plocha: 156 m²
- Energetická náročnost: A
- Lokalita: 4 Seachnall Abbey, Dunshaughlin
